item.title: Show HN: Tocic – Chatbot table of content browser extension
item.summary: When using chatbots, I often lose track of which question the response I’m reading is answering. It is even more confusing when scroll up and down looking for a previous answer to a particular query. In a wall of text, I have no way to tell. So I made this simple browser extension to give me a simple table of content. It works on chatgpt.com, claude.ai, grok.com and gemini.google.com. I use the firefox version daily. Not tested on chrome Source code at https://github.com/kmcheung12/tocic Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49217206 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
